authorization.this_stage: v3_scope_isolation_implementation_and_validation_only; real chain resubmission requires separate authority

input.events: Every eligible causal packet, not only selected queries; current-inclusive snapshot
input.burst_construction: Full accepted event stream; no regroup after thinning
input.field_encoding: Old no-payload header grammar, window-local old first-two-row seq/ack anchors
input.directions_for_e3: First retained source within the current window
input.forward: Pinned old E3 float32/eval and masked mean, no encoder training
input.invalid_data: STOP; do not drop query or silently substitute features

anomalies.order: Contiguous capture frame order; no timestamp sorting
anomalies.regression: Namespace-local integer ns monotonicity; poison to capture end, no idle unpoison; target intersection STOP
anomalies.cross_key: Record capture-time regressions without global failure
anomalies.payload_truncation: Complete required headers update tokens/state; query ineligible
anomalies.missing_headers: No default values, no token/state update; namespace taint until a proven >60s gap between adjacent eligible events resets ALL history; affected fixed targets STOP
anomalies.missing_key: Unique required owner with supported protocol and missing namespace headers STOP; proven outside-required owner is recorded before key/header checks, no fabricated namespace
anomalies.reconciliation: Full legacy all-owner replay and static receipts retained; per-frame namespace/regression/incomplete identity for required owners; all receipt INCOMPLETE_TARGET events must be outside-required-owner; early/main digests agree

owner_scope_isolation.required_owners: Capture-local union of every frozen query and reference owner, across all roles, no label/score/time filtering
owner_scope_isolation.registry: Retain full known-owner registry for uniqueness and multi-owner rejection
owner_scope_isolation.order: Capture continuity/time -> full registry owner match -> outside-required unique owner recorded/return -> unchanged v2 protocol/header/state logic
owner_scope_isolation.target_safety: All required-owner eligible context retained; missing required headers still fail/taint; no fixed UID removed
owner_scope_isolation.capacity: Outside-required frames do not enter states, ledger, poison, taint or eviction; shared caps unchanged
owner_scope_isolation.audit: Full legacy receipts; scoped identities; assert receipt incomplete events are all outside-required owners
owner_scope_isolation.fixture: Pinned real 1135180/1135181 header fixture, outside owner invariant and required owner STOP

data.split_rule: All reference-sharing components FIT; other whole components: SHA256(salt|device|component) mod5 ==0 CAL, otherwise FIT
data.reference_allowlist: Exact previously used role UIDs; no extension or protocol filling
data.source_raw_support_gate: Final FIT must include legal TCP SYN&&!ACK and normal TCP; count devices/components and rates, nonzero is not sufficient generalization evidence

model.normalizer: Unweighted population mean/std over source FIT only; scale=max(std,1e-6); no clipping
model.metric_input: Safely L2 normalize standardized E3/state blocks, each /sqrt(2), concatenate and safely L2 normalize
model.safe_L2: v/max(norm(v),1e-12); finite zero maps to zero and is counted
model.metric: safe_L2(W*x); shared query/reference W; top min(2,n) mean per bank
model.reference_constraints: same protocol, whole bank end strictly before query, trusted normal, owner matched for normal query
model.no_reference_or_unregistered: new base classifier; never old R

training.numeric: CPU deterministic float32, 4threads/worker, float64 weights and loss accumulation
training.initialization: Per seed initialize standalone 768->128->1 with PyTorch Linear defaults; copy to OLD/RECENT and the E3 columns,bias/output of STATE; extra26 columns zero. W separate seed reset and orthogonal gain1.
training.ordering: Original manifest/cache UID order; fresh independent CPU Generator(seed) for randperm once/epoch; each eligible UID once
training.verifier_weights: 1/2 each class over original eligibility subset, same hierarchy; no H helpers
training.verifier_loss: N_eligible/b * sum(w_i*softplus(sign*10*similarity)); normal sign-1 own bank; attack sign+1 worst legal source bank
training.reference_subset_contract: SHA256(salt|seed|epoch0|device|protocol|reference_uid), then uid; UTF-8 and decimal integers

calibration.only_after: All endpoints and preprocessing sealed; no later optimization
calibration.base_threshold: Smallest candidate normal logit threshold with <=1% source CAL normal hierarchy-weighted FPR; strict >, no interpolation
calibration.aggregate: mean seed logits for base; mean same-bank seed similarities before metric max
calibration.reference_cut: max(0,max over all source CAL attacks and eligible source banks similarity)+1e-5
calibration.reference_cut_ge_1: Legal no-veto/no-gain outcome, not automatic relaxation

evaluation.metric_weights: Original metadata 1/label_metric_weight_denominator, checked against original census
evaluation.historical_Q_FULL: saved descriptive comparison, not matched intervention
evaluation.matched_wrong_reference: Reuse frozen original matched_control_plan rules on same UIDs/time/protocol/count, report unavailable cells; no new donor selected by scores
evaluation.small_support: Per device/rate TP and denominator alongside weighted and unweighted recall; absent attack_rate NOT_AVAILABLE

early_attack_diagnostic.purpose: descriptive only; no dedicated thresholds or optimization

evaluation.zero_counts: Stage delta and lifetime call-row counts; NOT unique examples

execution_delivery_requirements.authority: Not granted for real execution by this design; later explicit authority can cover whole delivered chain without per-stage questions
execution_delivery_requirements.operator: User uploads/submits/pulls; assistant packages and reviews
execution_delivery_requirements.time_memory_disk_runtime_contract: Must be sealed in implementation delivery before submission
execution_delivery_requirements.source_cache_audit: Fold missing old LEARN/DEV hashes/tails into P; reject incomplete local preallocated arrays
execution_delivery_requirements.new_raw_decode: Required eventually; unavailable current content cannot be recovered from old truncated flows
execution_delivery_requirements.resource_guard: One integrated target probe; stop before bulk E3 if projected fixed budget exceeded; never thin denominators

anomaly_preflight.order: Static receipt/UID/bank/control validation -> four capture decode, no E3 -> ordinary sorted reconstruction with full audit -> E3
anomaly_preflight.cost: Four extra capture decodes only; elapsed time charged to same 70h budget; no minutes guarantee
anomaly_preflight.agreement: Early/main anomaly and fixed-target identity stream digests must match exactly
anomaly_preflight.reserve: 12h T+K reserve is a budget, not measured runtime guarantee
